verdict.rationale: Radar rules can trigger 3DS for risky/new-customer transactions (stripe-radar-docs-1) and geo-based rules exist (stripe-radar-docs-17), but the evidence pack has no mention of SCA exemption requests (low-value, TRA, whitelisting) being handled by Radar, which is core to the 'exemptions requested when safe' half of the story. missing for 10: exemption request logic, explicit SCA/3DS decisioning engine documentation, evidence of automatic compliance-vs-conversion balancing beyond manual rule authoring.
